newsitem.title: USA: Janus group has 18.9 pct Abercrombie stake.
newsitem.headline: Janus group has 18.9 pct Abercrombie stake.

text.p: A group led by Janus Capital Corp said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing Wednesday it holds an 18.9 percent stake in Abercrombie and Fitch Co or 1,324,000 Class A common shares.
The group disclosed its latest position on Abercrombie and Fitch in a 13G filing.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.
